Script: How to actually grow an audience from scratch

Growing on social media is easy.

There, I said it.

I never really had a problem gaining followers, but that could be unconscious competence.

Note: This is a more tactical post. If you get your panties in a bunch when people talk about growing on social media, nobody is holding you hostage and forcing you to read this.

When I started on social media, I wasn't starting from scratch. I was starting with nearly a dozen failures under my belt. I failed at digital art, drop shipping, multiple agency businesses (ads, SEO, web design), freelance photography, and more.

As a teenager, my entire goal was to make some kind of online business work so that I would never have to work a full time 9-5 in my life.

How to grow an audience · Yesterday

“Your work is the byproduct of the way you see the world.”

Dan Koe
Ideas worth exploring · 2h
19:18
How to Build a Profitable Personal Brand (In Just 30 Days)

Matt Gray

390K views
769×
Top 1%
Personal branding · Yesterday

Build a body of work that makes your interests useful to other people.

A note to remember · Yesterday
Purpose & Profit · Books

A good idea is not a destination. It is a direction worth exploring.

Favorite ideas · 3d
Creative minds feel the difference within days.

Noah Little
Founder · The Success Squad
One week with using this platform, and I've gone viral three times in a week!!! Which happens typically only about once a month.

Writer

AL

Founder · The Karuna Lab

NI
Nick Neve
Relationships With A Soul
I have been able to pump out consistent, quality content monthly and currently, I have over 50 scripts backlogged, ready to shoot. I no longer feel the stress of having to come up with ideas each week and can focus way more on creating and publishing.
PA
Patrick
Creator
I went from around 8k–20k impressions per thread to ones capable of landing somewhere between 100k and 600k.
Built for the modern creative
A place for your ideas.
The tools to put them out into the world.
And a way to get paid for them.
Meet Eve
Meet your thinking partner.

Eve reads everything you save, your highlights, X bookmarks, and notes, and finds the threads between them. Most mornings she sends you an idea worth thinking about. When one clicks, she helps you think it through and start writing.

What have I read on this?
Is this idea working?
Which titles work?
What shape fits?
What do the books I've read say about getting my focus back?
Your highlights· focus and attention · 3 books

Three books you've highlighted keep landing on the same idea.

we can experience pleasure without any investment of psychic energy, whereas enjoyment happens only as a result of unusual investments of attention.
Flow
Mihaly Csikszentmihalyi
it is not constant effort that delivers results but a kind of constant, patient, unhurried focus that organizes the investigator’s attention when at work and is present but watchful during periods of ease.
Rest
Alex Soojung-Kim Pang
Part of the struggle in learning to write is learning to ignore what isn’t useful to you and pay attention to what is.
Several Short Sentences About Writing
Verlyn Klinkenborg

The thread: scrolling is pleasure, and pleasure is free. Focus pays you back, but only after you invest attention first. That's your angle. You didn't lose your focus. You stopped investing it.

Want me to outline a post from these?

Message Eve
Eve Fast
Start with Eve
See how Eve works
01 · Find your direction
Figure out what you're here to say.

Answer a few questions and Eden builds your content pillars, finds the topics getting views in your space right now, and writes dozens of post ideas for each one. No more blank page.

Build your strategy

See which ideas people are hungry for.

You scroll for hours and still don't know what to post. Search any topic and see the posts doing 10x their creator's normal on 7 platforms, so every idea starts with proof.

A home for every idea you find.
